xc_files.plain_code:
var $panel = panel(center, 50, 50)
var $beacon = beacon("", "THOR X8_T")
var $beacon1 = beacon("", "")
var $DATA1 = ""
var $CIBLE : text


function @target_beacon($b:beacon, $p:panel, $width:number, $height:number, $color:number)
	if $b.direction_z > 0
		var $f = screen_w / (2 * tan(fov / 2))
		var $rz = $b.direction_z * (screen_w / screen_h)
		var $x_proj = ($b.direction_x * $f) / $rz
		var $y_proj = ($b.direction_y * $f) / $rz
		var $x = screen_w / 2 + $x_proj - $width / 2
		var $y = screen_h / 2 - $y_proj - $height / 2
		$p.set_position($x, $y)
		$p.set_size($width, $height)
		$p.blank()
		;$p.draw_circle($width, $height, 0, $color)
		$p.draw_rect(0, 0, $width, $height, $color)
		$p.text_align(center)
		$p.write(text("{0.000}\n\nkm", $b.distance/1000))
		
		
init
	$DATA1 = $beacon.data
	$CIBLE = text($DATA1.CIBLE, $DATA1)
	$beacon1 = beacon("", text("{}", $CIBLE))
	
	
tick
	$panel.blank()
	$DATA1 = $beacon.data
	$CIBLE = text($DATA1.CIBLE, $DATA1)
	@target_beacon ($beacon1, $panel, 50, 50, green)

const $DBT1_io = "DB_1"
const $beacon = "BEACON_DOCK"
var $screen1 = screen($DBT1_io, 10)


var $receive_digit1_1 = 1
var $receive_digit2_2 = 0 
var $receive_digit3_3 = 0 
var $receive_digit4_4 = 0
var $CANAL : number
var $ancien_canal = 1000
var $CMD_ON_OFF = 0

function @gerer_digit($s:screen, $val:number, $pos_x:number, $min:number) : number
	if $s.button_triangle($pos_x, $s.height - 28, $pos_x - 2, $s.height - 21, $pos_x + 2, $s.height - 21, RED, yellow) and $val < 9
		$val = $val + 1
	if $s.button_triangle($pos_x, $s.height - 2, $pos_x - 2, $s.height - 9, $pos_x + 2, $s.height - 9, RED, yellow) and $val > $min
		$val = $val - 1
	return $val


update		
	var $canal_lu = input_number($beacon, 0)
	$CMD_ON_OFF = 0
	$screen1.blank()
	$screen1.text_size(1)
	$screen1.write(0, 3, CYAN, "BEACON:")

	var $canal_val = $receive_digit1_1*1000 + $receive_digit2_2*100 + $receive_digit3_3*10 + $receive_digit4_4
	$screen1.write(8, 22, CYAN, text("{}", $canal_val))
	
	$receive_digit1_1 = @gerer_digit($screen1, $receive_digit1_1, 10, 1)
	$receive_digit2_2 = @gerer_digit($screen1, $receive_digit2_2, 16, 0)
	$receive_digit3_3 = @gerer_digit($screen1, $receive_digit3_3, 22, 0)
	$receive_digit4_4 = @gerer_digit($screen1, $receive_digit4_4, 28, 0)
	
	$canal_val = $receive_digit1_1*1000 + $receive_digit2_2*100 + $receive_digit3_3*10 + $receive_digit4_4
	
	output_number($beacon, 2, $canal_val)
	
	$screen1.write(8, 22, CYAN, text("{}", $canal_val))
	
	if $canal_val <> $ancien_canal
		$CMD_ON_OFF = 1
		$ancien_canal = $canal_val
		output_number($beacon, 2, $canal_val)
	
	$CANAL = $canal_val

const $DB = "DB_4"
const $nav_io = "NAV"
;var $hud = screen("DB_4", 0)
var $screen = screen("DB_4", 0)
var $counter = 0


function @DRAW_HORIZON($scr:screen, $pitch:number, $roll:number)
	var $cx = 100
	var $cy = 75
	
	var $horizon_y = $cy - ($pitch * 100)
	
	var $angle = $roll * 3.1416
	
	var $half_width = 35
	var $x_offset = $half_width * cos($angle)
	var $y_offset = $half_width * sin($angle)
	
	$scr.draw_line($cx - $x_offset, $horizon_y - $y_offset, $cx - 9 * cos($angle), $horizon_y - 10 * sin($angle), green)

	$scr.draw_line($cx + 10 * cos($angle), $horizon_y + 10 * sin($angle), $cx + $x_offset, $horizon_y + $y_offset, green)
	
	$scr.draw_point($cx, $horizon_y, green)

function @DRAW_FLIGHT_PATH($scr:screen, $v_avant:number, $v_vert:number, $v_droite:number)
	var $cx = 100
	var $cy = 75
	
	var $fpm_x = $cx + ($v_droite * 1.5)
	var $fpm_y = $cy - ($v_vert * 1.5)
	
	if $fpm_x > 180
		$fpm_x = 180
	if $fpm_x < 20
		$fpm_x = 20
	if $fpm_y > 85
		$fpm_y = 85
	if $fpm_y < 5
		$fpm_y = 5
	
	$scr.draw_circle($fpm_x, $fpm_y, 4, green)
	$scr.draw_line($fpm_x - 8, $fpm_y, $fpm_x - 4, $fpm_y, green)
	$scr.draw_line($fpm_x + 5, $fpm_y, $fpm_x + 9, $fpm_y, green)
	$scr.draw_line($fpm_x, $fpm_y - 8, $fpm_x, $fpm_y - 4, green)

function @DRAW_RETICLE($scr:screen)
	$scr.blank(0)
	
	var $cx = $scr.width / 2
	var $cy = $scr.height / 2.26
	
	$scr.draw_line($cx - 3, $cy, $cx - 10, $cy, white)
	$scr.draw_line($cx + 3, $cy, $cx + 10, $cy, white)
	$scr.draw_circle($cx, $cy, 2, red)


update
	$screen.blank(0)
	
	@DRAW_RETICLE($screen)
	
	var $pitch = input_number($nav_io, 4)
	var $roll = input_number($nav_io, 5)
	var $v_vert = input_number($nav_io, 1)
	var $v_droite = input_number($nav_io, 12)
	
	;var $cxH = 100
	;var $cyH = 75
	;$screen.draw_circle($cxH, $cyH, 1, red)
	
	@DRAW_HORIZON($screen, $pitch, $roll)
	@DRAW_FLIGHT_PATH($screen, 0, $v_vert, $v_droite)
	
	$screen.write(5, 113, cyan, "SP Horizontal: ")
	$screen.write(95, 113, green, text("{0.00} Km/h", $VIT_H))
	$screen.write(5, 123, cyan, text("SP Vertical  : {0.00} Km/h", $VIT_V))
	$screen.write(5, 135, cyan, "ALT Ground   : ")
	$screen.write(95, 135, yellow, text("{0.00} M", $ALT_T))
	$screen.write(5, 145, cyan, text("ALT Sea      : {0.00} M", $ALT_M))
	
		
	$counter = $counter + 1
	if $counter > 50
		$counter = 0
	
	var $cx = $screen.width / 2   ; 100
	var $cy = $screen.height / 2   ; 85
	
	var $ANT_ON_OFF = input_number("BEACON_DOCK", 5)
	
	if $ANT_ON_OFF == 0
		$screen.write(75, 5, yellow, "NO TARGET")
	
	if $ANT_ON_OFF == 1
		var $hors_champ = 0
		var $dir_h = 0
		var $dir_v = 0
		
		if $Z >= 0
			$hors_champ = 1
		
		if $Z < 0
			
			var $px = $cx + (($X / -$Z) * $cx)
			var $py = $cy - (($Y / -$Z) * $cy)
			
			if $px < 0
				$hors_champ = 1
				$dir_h = -1
			if $px > $screen.width
				$hors_champ = 1
				$dir_h = 1
			if $py < 0
				$hors_champ = 1
				$dir_v = -1
			if $py > $screen.height
				$hors_champ = 1
				$dir_v = 1		
			
			if $hors_champ == 0
				$screen.draw_circle($px, $py, 7, red)
				$screen.draw_line($px - 5, $py, $px + 6, $py, green)
				$screen.draw_line($px, $py - 5, $px, $py + 6, green)
				;$screen.write($px + 8, $py - 3, cyan, text("Dist: {0.000} Km", $M / 1000))
				$screen.write(5, 5, cyan, "Target Name: ")
				$screen.write(5, 15, cyan, "Target Dist: ")
				$screen.write(80, 15, yellow, text("{0.000} Km", $M / 1000))
				$screen.write(80, 5, green, text("{}", input_text($beacon, 0)))
		
		if $hors_champ == 1
			$screen.write(55, 5, red, "OFF-SCREEN TARGET")
			
			if $counter > 25
				if $dir_h == -1
					$screen.write(3, 70, red, "  TARGET\n<<\n  LEFT")
				if $dir_h == 1
					$screen.write($screen.width - 50, 70, red, "TARGET\n      >>\nRIGHT")
				if $dir_v == -1
					$screen.write($cx - 15, 15, red, "  ^^\nTARGET\nUP")
				if $dir_v == 1
					$screen.write($cx - 15, $screen.height - 80, red, "TARGET\nDOWN\n  vv")

const $directionconst = 45.000000
const $north = 0.000000
const $northeast = 45.000000
const $east = 90.000000
const $seast = 135.000000
const $south = 180.000000
const $southw = 225.000000
const $west = 270.000000
const $northwest = 315.000000
const $northcorrection = 360.000000

const $northtext = "NORTH"
const $northeasttext = "NORTH EAST"
const $easttext = "EAST"
const $southeasttext = "SOUTH EAST"
const $southtext = "SOUTH"
const $southwesttext = "SOUTH WEST"
const $westtext = "WEST"
const $northwesttext = "NORTH WEST"

var $screen_heading = screen("DB_1", 0)

function @GET_CARDINAL($_angle:number):text
	var $_switch1 = ""
	var $_switch1_ = ((((($_angle > ($northeast - ($directionconst / 2))) + ($_angle > ($east - ($directionconst / 2)))) + (($_angle > ($seast - ($directionconst / 2))) + ($_angle > ($south - ($directionconst / 2))))) + ((($_angle > ($southw - ($directionconst / 2))) + ($_angle > ($west - ($directionconst / 2)))) + ($_angle > ($northwest - ($directionconst / 2))))) * (!($_angle > ($northcorrection - ($directionconst / 2)))))
	
	if $_switch1_ == 0
		$_switch1 = $northtext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 1
		$_switch1 = $northeasttext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 2
		$_switch1 = $easttext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 3
		$_switch1 = $southeasttext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 4
		$_switch1 = $southtext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 5
		$_switch1 = $southwesttext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 6
		$_switch1 = $westtext
	elseif $_switch1_ == 7
		$_switch1 = $northwesttext
		
	return $_switch1

update
	$screen_heading.blank(0)
	
	var $_input_alias_1 = input_number("NAV", 6)
	var $_text_cardinal = @GET_CARDINAL($_input_alias_1)
	
	var $_text1 = text("{}: {0.0}°", $_text_cardinal, $_input_alias_1)
	var $_text2 = text("\n\nTHOR X8: {0}°", $_input_alias_1)
	
	;var $_expr1 = $_text1 & $_text2
	
	$screen_heading.write(8, 5, green, $_text1)
	$screen_heading.write(23, 2, color(100, 200, 255), $_text2)
	
	;output_text("DB_1", 0, $_expr1)

;const $DBHG = "DB_3"
var $screenG = screen("DB_3", 2)

var $pist_1 = 0
var $pist_2 = 0
var $pist_3 = 0

function @GYRO($sg:screen, $input_name:text, $label:text, $pos_y:number, $id:number)
	var $vg = input_number($input_name, 0)
	
	$sg.write(3, $pos_y, white, $label)
	
	var $line_top = $pos_y - 2
	var $line_bottom = $pos_y + 6
	
	$sg.draw_line(70, $line_top, 129, $line_top, gray)
	$sg.draw_line(70, $line_bottom, 130, $line_bottom, gray)
	$sg.draw_line(70, $line_top, 70, $line_bottom, gray)
	$sg.draw_line(129, $line_top, 129, $line_bottom, gray)
	
	var $cg = green
	
	if $id == 1
		if $vg < $pist_1
			$cg = red
		$pist_1 = $vg
		
	if $id == 2
		if $vg < $pist_2
			$cg = red
		$pist_2 = $vg
		
	if $id == 3
		if $vg < $pist_3
			$cg = red
		$pist_3 = $vg
	
	var $jg = abs($vg * 6)
	
	if $jg > 58
		$jg = 58
	
	if $jg > 0
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 1, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 1, $cg)
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 2, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 2, $cg)
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 3, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 3, $cg)
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 4, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 4, $cg)
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 5, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 5, $cg)
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 6, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 6, $cg)
		$sg.draw_line(71, $line_top + 7, 71 + $jg, $line_top + 7, $cg)
		
		
update
	$screenG.blank()
	$screenG.text_size(1)
	
	$screenG.write(43, 3, cyan, "GYROSCOPE")

	@GYRO($screenG, "GYRO-GD", "LEFT/RIGHT", 17, 1)
	@GYRO($screenG, "GYRO-ROLL", "ROLL", 28, 2)
	@GYRO($screenG, "GYRO-PITCH", "PITCH", 39, 3)

const $DBHG = "DB_3"
const $DBHD = "DB_2"
var $screenHG = screen("DB_3", 0)
var $screenHD = screen("DB_2", 0)


function @helices($s:screen, $input_name:text, $label:text, $pos_y:number, $invert:number)
	var $v = input_number($input_name, 0)
	var $t = input_number($input_name, 1)
	
	$s.write(3, $pos_y, white, $label)
	
	var $line_top = $pos_y - 2
	var $line_bottom = $pos_y + 6
	
	$s.draw_line(70, $line_top, 129, $line_top, gray)
	$s.draw_line(70, $line_bottom, 130, $line_bottom, gray)
	$s.draw_line(70, $line_top, 70, $line_bottom, gray)
	$s.draw_line(129, $line_top, 129, $line_bottom, gray)
	
	var $j = abs($v)
	var $c = green
	
	if $invert == 0
		if $t < 0
			$c = yellow
		
		if $j > 58
			$j = 58
		
		if $j > 0
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 1, 71 + $j, $line_top + 1, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 2, 71 + $j, $line_top + 2, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 3, 71 + $j, $line_top + 3, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 4, 71 + $j, $line_top + 4, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 5, 71 + $j, $line_top + 5, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 6, 71 + $j, $line_top + 6, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 7, 71 + $j, $line_top + 7, $c)
		
		$s.write(135, $pos_y, cyan, text("{0}N", $t))
	
	if $invert == 1
		$c = yellow
		if $t < 0
			$c = green
		
		if $j > 58
			$j = 58
		
		if $j > 0
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 1, 71 + $j, $line_top + 1, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 2, 71 + $j, $line_top + 2, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 3, 71 + $j, $line_top + 3, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 4, 71 + $j, $line_top + 4, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 5, 71 + $j, $line_top + 5, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 6, 71 + $j, $line_top + 6, $c)
			$s.draw_line(71, $line_top + 7, 71 + $j, $line_top + 7, $c)
		
		$s.write(135, $pos_y, cyan, text("{0}N", -$t))

update
	$screenHG.blank()
	$screenHD.blank()
	;$screenHG.text_size(1)
	;$screenHD.text_size(1)
	
	$screenHG.write(25, 3, cyan, "TELEMETRY PROPELLER LEFT")
	$screenHD.write(22, 3, cyan, "TELEMETRY PROPELLER RIGHT")
	
	@helices($screenHG, "PRO-G-AV-H", "BEFORE UP", 17, 0)
	@helices($screenHG, "PRO-G-AR-H", "REAR UP", 28, 0)
	@helices($screenHG, "PRO-G-AV-B", "BEFORE DOWN", 39, 1)
	@helices($screenHG, "PRO-G-AR-B", "REAR DOWN", 50, 1)

	@helices($screenHD, "PRO-D-AV-H", "BEFORE UP", 17, 0)
	@helices($screenHD, "PRO-D-AR-H", "REAR UP", 28, 0)
	@helices($screenHD, "PRO-D-AV-B", "BEFORE DOWN", 39, 1)
	@helices($screenHD, "PRO-D-AR-B", "REAR DOWN", 50, 1)

var $TRAIN_S : text
var $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1_last_up = 0
var $_Tableau_de_bord_delay1 = 0

var $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2_last_up = 0
var $_Tableau_de_bord_delay2 = 0
var $ACTIVER : text
var $OFF1 : text
var $DRONE1 : text
var $DRONE2 : text

update
	if 1
		$SPORT = "SPORT"
	if ((1 * $BLINKER) + (1 * $COOL))
		$SPORT = ""
	if ((1 * (!$BRAKE1)) * 1)
		$FREIN1 = "OFF"
	if (1 * $FREIN)
		$FREIN1 = ""
	if 1
		$COOL1 = "NORMAL"
	if (!(1 * $COOL))
		$COOL1 = ""
	if ((1 * (!$BRAKE1)) * 1)
		$AUTO1 = "AUTO"
	if ((1 * $BLINKER) + (!(1 * $FREIN)))
		$AUTO1 = ""
	var $_text1 = text("    ATTENTION\n200 Km/h OUTRUN", "")
	if (!(1 * $DRONE_GO))
		$VIT1_200 = $_text1
	if ((1 * $BLINKER) + (!(1 * $VIT_200)))
		$VIT1_200 = ""
	var $_text2 = text("'UP/DOWN'\n BECOMES\n 'PITCH'", "")
	if (!(1 * $DRONE_GO))
		$VIT2_200 = $_text2
	if (!(1 * $VIT_200))
		$VIT2_200 = ""
	if (!(1 * $DRONE_GO))
		$BRAKE2 = "MANUAL"
	if (!$BRAKE1)
		$BRAKE2 = ""
	var $_text3 = text("LANDING\n GEAR\nEXTENTED", "")
	var $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1 = 0
	var $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1_up_ = (1 * $TRAIN)
	if $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1_up_ and !$_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1_last_up
		$_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1!!
	$_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1_last_up = $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1_up_
	var $_Tableau_de_bord_delay1_ = $_Tableau_de_bord_delay1 > 0 and $_Tableau_de_bord_delay1 < time
	if $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse1
		$_Tableau_de_bord_delay1 = time + 10
	if ((!$_Tableau_de_bord_delay1_) * (!(1 * $DRONE_GO)))
		$TRAIN_S = $_text3
	if ((1 * $BLINKER) + (!(1 * $TRAIN)))
		$TRAIN_S = ""
	var $_text4 = text("RETRACT\nLANDING\n GEAR", "")
	var $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2 = 0
	var $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2_up_ = (!(1 * $TRAIN))
	if $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2_up_ and !$_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2_last_up
		$_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2!!
	$_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2_last_up = $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2_up_
	var $_Tableau_de_bord_delay2_ = $_Tableau_de_bord_delay2 > 0 and $_Tableau_de_bord_delay2 < time
	if $_Tableau_de_bord_pulse2
		$_Tableau_de_bord_delay2 = time + 5
	if ((!$_Tableau_de_bord_delay2_) * (!(1 * $DRONE_GO)))
		$TRAIN_R = $_text4
	if ((1 * $TRAIN) + $_Tableau_de_bord_delay2_)
		$TRAIN_R = ""
	output_number("DS", 0, $ANTI_C)
	output_number("DS", 1, 0)
	output_number("DS", 2, 600)
	if 1

const $TB = "DB_1"
const $TB3 = "DB_3"


var $screenTB = screen("DB_1", 4)
var $screenTB1 = screen("DB_1", 3)

var $screenTB4 = screen("DB_3", 4)
var $screenTB5 = screen("DB_3", 6)
var $screenTB6 = screen("DB_1", 20)
var $screenTB7 = screen("DB_1", 21)

	
function @draw_energie1($s:screen, $en:number)

	var $couleur_fond = red
	var $etat_texte = "OFF"
	
	if $en == 1
		$couleur_fond = green
		$etat_texte = "YES"
	$s.blank($couleur_fond)
	$s.text_size(1)
	
	$s.write(2, 6, black, text("{}", $etat_texte))	
	

function @draw_energie2($s:screen, $en:number)

	var $couleur_fond = red
	var $etat_texte = "OFF"
	
	if $en == 1
		$couleur_fond = green
		$etat_texte = "YES"
	$s.blank($couleur_fond)
	$s.text_size(1)
	
	$s.write(2, 2, black, text("{}", $etat_texte))


function @LIGNE($s1:screen, $input_name:text, $label:text, $pos_y:number, $invert:number)
	$s1.write(3, $pos_y, white, $label)
	
	var $line_top = $pos_y - 2
	
	var $j1 = 100
	var $c1 = white
	
	$s1.draw_line(0, $line_top + 1, 20 + $j1, $line_top + 1, $c1)
	$s1.draw_line(0, $line_top + 31, 20 + $j1, $line_top + 31, $c1)
	$s1.draw_line(0, $line_top + 51, 20 + $j1, $line_top + 51, $c1)
	$s1.draw_line(0, $line_top + 52, -100 + $j1, $line_top + 0, $c1)


update	
	
	$screenTB.blank()
	$screenTB1.blank()
	$screenTB2.blank()
	$screenTB3.blank()
	$screenTB4.blank()
	$screenTB5.blank()

	
	
	@draw_energie1($screenTB1, $ENERGIE)
	@draw_energie1($screenTB2, $HELICE)
	@draw_energie1($screenTB5, $DRONE_GO)
	@draw_energie2($screenTB6, $DOCK)
	@draw_energie2($screenTB7, $LUMI)
	
	@LIGNE($screenTB)
	
	
	$screenTB.write(20, 6, cyan, "DRIVING MODE:\n")
	$screenTB.write(45, 18, red, $SPORT)
	$screenTB.write(42, 18, green, $COOL1)
	
	$screenTB.write(5, 36, cyan, "BRAKE + GEAR:")
	$screenTB.write(85, 36, green, $FREIN1)
	$screenTB.write(85, 36, red, $AUTO1)
	$screenTB.write(83, 36, red, $BRAKE2)
	
	$screenTB3.write(26, 3, cyan, "INFO THOR X8")
	$screenTB3.write(12, 15, red, $VIT1_200)
	$screenTB3.write(35, 33, green, $VIT2_200)
	
	$screenTB3.write(1, 15, red, $DRONE1)
	$screenTB3.write(16, 26, green, $DRONE2)

	$screenTB3.write(36, 23, red, $TRAIN_S)
	$screenTB3.write(36, 23, green, $TRAIN_R)
	
	$screenTB4.write(7, 2, cyan, "  ANTI-\nCOLLISION:")
	$screenTB4.write(10, 20, green, $ACTIVER)
	$screenTB4.write(25, 20, red, $OFF1)
